title: Produce Traceability Checklist
subtitle: Produce Traceability: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Produce Traceability Checklist covers produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event. The traceability coordinator records Produce Traceability criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Produce Traceability Checklist keeps Produce Traceability exceptions visible until the traceability coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Produce Traceability Checklist at field, harvest, packing, storage, shipment, and receiving point. Document produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event identity before Produce Traceability begins. Compare produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event findings with stated Produce Traceability criteria; route unresolved Produce Traceability issues to qualified produce-record reviewer. For Produce Traceability Checklist, confirm requirements for Produce Traceability. Ask qualified produce-record reviewer to review Produce Traceability conditions beyond the traceability coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Produce Traceability, identify responsible parties, field, harvest, packing, storage, shipment, and receiving point, and the linked produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event source.

fields.label: Grower, field, harvest date, and crew
Pack, pallet, shipment, customer, and destination

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Produce Traceability facts for produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability inspection checks
items: Trace exercise, discrepancy, and corrective action

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Produce Traceability finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Traceability Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Produce Traceability when source, lot, quantity, transformation, recipient, or affected-scope trace remains unresolved. Retain the available Produce Traceability proof and route unresolved produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event scope to traceability coordinator.
